title: Message templates
description: WhatsApp checks each template before you can send it to someone who hasn't written to you first.
unavailable: We couldn't read your templates just now.
noneBody: Until you have one, you can only continue conversations other people start — never begin one.
window: Once someone writes to you, WhatsApp lets you reply freely for 24 hours — no template needed. Templates are for reaching someone before that.
